title: WoW Forever Recipe Explorer
description: Client DB2 data from wago.tools, normalized. Money values are in copper.

recipes_by_profession.title: Recipes by profession
recipes_by_profession.sql: SELECT * FROM v_recipes WHERE complete AND profession LIKE :profession || '%' ORDER BY skill_yellow, name

skillup_options.title: Recipes that still give skill-ups at a skill level
skillup_options.sql: SELECT * FROM v_recipes WHERE complete AND profession LIKE :profession || '%' AND coalesce(min_skill, 0) <= CAST(:skill AS INTEGER) AND skill_grey > CAST(:skill AS INTEGER) ORDER BY skill_yellow, name

what_uses_item.title: What uses this reagent?
what_uses_item.sql: SELECT * FROM v_reagent_usage WHERE complete AND reagent LIKE '%' || :item || '%' ORDER BY profession, skill_yellow

how_to_make_item.title: How is this item made?
how_to_make_item.sql: SELECT * FROM v_recipes WHERE complete AND product LIKE '%' || :item || '%' ORDER BY profession, skill_yellow

recipes_with_latest_prices.title: Recipes with latest AH prices (needs imported prices)
recipes_with_latest_prices.sql: SELECT r.spell_id, r.name, r.profession, r.product, r.product_count, lp.market_value AS product_market_value, lp.min_buyout AS product_min_buyout, lp.observed_at FROM gamedata.v_recipes r JOIN prices.latest_prices lp ON lp.item_id = r.product_item_id WHERE r.complete AND lp.realm = :realm ORDER BY r.profession, r.skill_yellow
